 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing a residential housing project named and styled as ‘ ZAMEEN OPAL ’ consisting of residential apartments located at Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the plan for the Project and the Floor Plan of the apartment(s) and desires to purchase the apartment more fully described in Description of Unit (“ Unit ”) ; and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to construct and sell the Unit to the Buyer on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase Price, the Developer will construct and sell the rights in the Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement (the “Agreement” ): 
 
 Description of Unit; 
 This Agreement to Sell; 
 General Terms and Conditions hereof ; 
 Nominees Form ; 
 Attachment A: Provisional Allotment Letter 
 Attachment B : Payment Plan; 
 Attachment C : Unit Floor Plan; and 
 Any other document forming part of the Agreement pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Unit. Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 
 
 BUYER’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause REF _Hlk93504665 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 3.3 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of all Units, including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies, Parking Space and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Units and do not form part of any given Unit. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement. 
 
 Completion or Estimated 
 Completion Date means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Unit will be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause REF _Ref98336117 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 5 ( Construction and Possession of Unit ) of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, petroleum, diesel, labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the Project . 
 
 Developer means D EEVAR DEVELOP ERS (PRIVATE) LIMITED , a wholly owned subsidiary of Zameen Developments (Private) Limited. 
 
 Down Payment means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties in writing . 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment, including the payments mentioned in the Payment Plan, is required to be paid by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause REF _Ref98336344 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 14.1 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment (including Down Payment) to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan. For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may, subject to Clause REF _Hlk93504665 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 3.3 , include any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of maintaining, operating or managing the Project or any part thereof, including, inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Nominee means such person, as may be nominated by the Buyer as the person who may facilitate in the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer, under the Agreement to Sell, to Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of demise of the Buyer. 
 
 Parking Space means the parking space allocated for the exclusive use of the Buyer or occupants of the Unit . 
 
 Party means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Attachment B of the Agreement to Sell , setting out the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer . 
 
 Permitted Use means the permissible nature and use of the Unit as a residential unit , strictly in accordance with the Rules (defined below) . 
 
 Project means the real estate residential apartment complex, named and styled as ‘Zameen Opal’, being developed by the Developer. 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Buyer to purchase the Unit (exclusive of tax), as identified in the Payment Plan in Attachment B to the Agreement to Sell , together with any Adjusted Amount or Adjusted Amount Instalment which may be payable under Clause REF _Hlk93504665 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 3.3 , as may be modified in terms hereof including under Clause REF _Ref98337586 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 9.2 . 
 
 Unit means the specific residential apartment which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Terms and Conditions of the Agreement to Sell as shown in the Unit Floor Plan . 
 
 Unit Floor Plan means the floor plan of the Unit and its location, as shown in Attachment C to the Agreement to Sell . 
 
 Rules means such rules as may be framed by the Developer and/or the Management Company and amended from time to time setting out the Buyer’s / Occupant’s rights and obligations in relation to the transfer/resale, use, occupancy, layout, maintenance, design and display of the Units. 
 
 Service Charges Advance means the Service Charges payable by the Buyer to the Management Company in advance at the time of possession of the Unit and in accordance with the Clause REF _Ref98339404 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 3(ii) of the General Terms and Conditions . 
 
 Service Charges means the amount payable by the Buyer to the Management Company bi-annually in advance , pursuant to the management agreement to be executed between the Parties, as proportionate contribution towards the management , administration, maintenance and control of the Project, without limitation the Unit , Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Space, which amount shall be determined and prescribed from time to time by the Management Company provided that such charges shall be reasonable, based on market standards and as per fair market rates. The amount of Service Charge shall be determined by the Management Company in its absolute discretion . The first such Service Charge will be payable as Service Charge Advance . 
 
 Taxes means any federal, provincial or local taxes or levies payable on any component used for the construction of the Unit (including the Component Materials). 
 Terms and Conditions means the Agreement, including these General Terms and Conditions to the Agreement to Sell, as may be amended or supplemented by the Developer from time to time at its sole discretion. 
 Other Unit (s) means any one or more of apartment or penthouse in the Project, other than the Unit. 
 1.2. Except where the context otherwise requires, references in the Agreement to: 
 An Article, Clause, attachment, or paragraph are references to an Article, Clause, attachment or paragraph of the Agreement or the relevant document comprising the Agreement; 
 Any headings in the Agreement are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 Any reference to a date or time is to such date and time in Islamabad, Pakistan; 
 Any reference to a Party shall, where the context permits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns; 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Agreement or any part of the Agreement; 
 Use of the terms “including”, “include” or “includes” shall be interpreted to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, unless otherwise specified; 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing include an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 “law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 Where there is a reference to “sell”, “sale” or other transfer of rights in any Unit by the Developer to the Buyer, such term refers to a sale of the Developer’s rights relating to the Unit concerned, including the right to occupy and use such Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to the General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 SALE OF UNIT 
 
 2.1 The Developer confirms that it has the necessary rights and title to the Project, to construct the Project and to sell the Unit and that it has received requisite approvals from Competent Authorities for the development of the Project. Further, the Developer agrees to construct the Project and sell the Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Unit from the Developer, strictly in accordance with the Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 2.2 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that only the title of the Unit shall be transferred to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall have no rights, title or interest in the Project other than the limited rights of access to Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Space as expressly provided herein. For the avoidance of doubt, the Developer shall at all times have all rights, title and interest with respect to the Common Areas, Common Facilities, Parking Space, roof and exterior walls. 
 
 PAYMENT 
 
 The consideration for construction and transfer of possession of the Unit by the Developer shall be subject to the following: 
 Payment of each Instalment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date, as more fully described in the Payment Plan in Attachment B of the Agreement, along with any applicable Adjusted Amount ; 
 Payment of one - time Service Charges Advance by the Buyer at the time of possession of the Unit , unless otherwise specified, to be determined as per fair market rates; 
 The Buyer’s formal written undertaking to inter alia pay all Service Charges to the Management Company, determined as per fair market rates, relating to the use and upkeep of the Common Areas, Common Facilities, and/or Parking Space ; 
 Payment by the Buyer of all, electricity, water, or other utility and meter connection charges, as per applicable laws, as and when due; 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable taxes, fees, stamp duties, levies (if any) related to the Unit as per Clause 5 below ; 
 In the event that the Buyer chooses to have his/her rights in the Unit recorded in the relevant department / revenue record, then completion of any and all formalities in relation thereto shall be solely fulfilled by the Buyer; and
